# Barakah Soft

> > Barakah Soft provides a comprehensive suite of free online tools for calculations, conversions, text processing, and AI-powered analysis, with detailed product comparisons for business software.

Barakah Soft offers practical utility tools designed for everyday calculations and conversions, complemented by in-depth comparison guides for enterprise software solutions. The platform combines functional tools with informative content to help users and businesses make informed decisions.

## Key Topics

- Date Calculator
- Time Difference
- Unit Converter
- Text Case Converter
- Password Generator
- BMI Calculator
- Age Calculator
- Percentage Calculator
- AI Face Personality Test
- Free Tools
- Feature Comparison
- Pricing Analysis
- Business Software
- Export to CSV/PDF
- Timezone Conversion

## Core Calculation & Conversion Tools

- [Date Calculator Difference](https://barakahsoft.com/date-calculator-difference): Calculate exact time intervals between dates in years, months, days
- [Unit Converter](https://barakahsoft.com/unit-converter): Convert 100+ units for length, weight, temperature, area, volume
- [Text Case Converter](https://barakahsoft.com/text-case-converter): Convert text between 10+ case styles including title, uppercase, lowercase
- [Percentage Calculator](https://barakahsoft.com/percentage-calculator): 5-in-1 calculator for percentages, discounts, and financial calculations
- [Age Calculator](https://barakahsoft.com/age-calculator): Calculate exact age in years, months, and days from birth date

## Security & Health Tools

- [Password Generator](https://barakahsoft.com/password-generator): Generate secure random passwords with customizable length and characters
- [BMI Calculator](https://barakahsoft.com/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index with personalized health insights
- [AI Face Personality Test](https://barakahsoft.com/ai-face-personality-test): AI facial analysis reveals personality traits and career recommendations
